agent-pi-eno.message: STARTED: Author buildDelegateEverythingSection() helper in extensions/lib/mode-prompts.ts. Helper will centralize the 'main agent delegates all reads/searches/execution to subagents' policy. Designing it as a parameterized function so NORMAL/PLAN/INVESTIGATE/SPEC/TEAM/CHAIN/PIPELINE can each inject mode-specific subagent names (scout, builder, run_chain, dispatch_agents, advance_phase, etc.) while sharing the core delegate-everything rules. Scope: extensions/lib/mode-prompts.ts only.

MODIFIED: extensions/lib/mode-prompts.ts — added DelegateEverythingOpts interface and buildDelegateEverythingSection() helper. Helper is parameterized over modeName, dispatchTool, dispatchExample, and optional extraRules so each consumer mode can inject its own dispatch idiom (subagent_create / dispatch_agent / run_chain / dispatch_agents). The core policy text is centralized — main agent thinks/plans/synthesizes only; reads/searches/execution/builds/tests all delegate. Drops the 'fall back to doing the work directly' carve-out; replaces it with 'Recovery, not Fallback' (dispatch a new subagent, don't take over). VERIFIED: 39/39 existing mode-prompts tests still pass.

COMPLETED: buildDelegateEverythingSection() helper added at extensions/lib/mode-prompts.ts:13-71. Ready for Wave 2 (tasks #3 #4 #5 #6) to consume. Files: extensions/lib/mode-prompts.ts. Escalations used: 0/2.
